risks.name: Policy/Regulatory
risks.description: Government or jurisdictional policy changes (e.g., moratoria, taxes, transfer restrictions, eligibility rules) suspend crediting or restrict transfers, reducing or delaying issuance and delivery.

risks.name: MRV/Data Integrity
risks.description: Inaccurate measurements, missing data, or tampering in monitoring lead to adverse verification findings and downscaled or rejected credits, delaying issuance.

risks.name: Finance/Counterparty
risks.description: Failure to secure/maintain project finance or offtaker/counterparty default disrupts build/operations or settlement, preventing generation or timely delivery of contracted credits.

risks.name: Execution/Schedule
risks.description: EPC delays, logistics bottlenecks, or contractor underperformance push commissioning and monitoring milestones, shifting or missing issuance windows.

risks.name: Legal/Permitting
risks.description: Missing or revoked permits, licenses, or compliance breaches halt activities or invalidate monitoring, blocking verification and issuance.

risks.name: Methodology/Baseline
risks.description: Incorrect baseline/additionality or adverse updates to approved methodologies reduce eligible volumes or require re-baselining, cutting units or stalling issuance.

risks.name: Technology/Performance
risks.description: Equipment or process underperformance versus design (e.g., capture/destruction efficiency) yields fewer abated/removed tonnes than forecast, lowering issuance.

risks.name: Operations/Feedstock
risks.description: Operational downtime, maintenance gaps, adoption shortfalls, or shortages of required inputs/feedstock reduce realized activity and monitoring completeness, decreasing or delaying issuances.

risks.name: Permanence/Reversal
risks.description: For sequestration projects, fires, pests, harvest, or soil/biomass loss reverse stored carbon, triggering buffer deductions or invalidation that cuts available issuance.

risks.name: Force Majeure
risks.description: Extreme weather, natural disasters, or conflict physically damage assets or restrict site access, interrupting monitoring periods and postponing credit generation and delivery.

risks.name: Land Tenure/FPIC
risks.description: Disputed land/resource rights or lack of Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) lead to injunctions or community blockades, suspending activities and jeopardizing verification.

risks.name: Leakage/Displacement
risks.description: Project activities induce emissions outside the boundary (activity or market leakage), requiring deductions that reduce credited quantity at issuance.

risks.name: Registry/Issuance
risks.description: Registry account issues, serial generation errors, or platform backlogs delay credit issuance or transfer, hindering timely delivery/settlement.
